reason: Measured with the html2pdf napi addon (turbo-html2pdf-consolidation 1b3c723, path-patched) built on the 0.7.0 integration head 10aa306 and on this change, same host: html2pdf 4 outputs, html2pdf-extra 3, html2pdf-svg 0. #243: an whose image does not decode is a replaced box sized like Chrome 156's broken image (16x16 icon without alt, the width/height attributes when both are set), and one with alt text shows that text inline after the 16px icon place. The default (non-svg) html2pdf build cannot decode the SVG s of image-img-svg-* (natural: 1256x0 -> 16x16; sized: 0 tall -> 120x120) or the SVG of extra-xref-anchors (a 1264x0 block -> the 41px alt text inline; #242 makes inline). The svg build decodes them all: zero diff. #241 (native advances for max-content) moves nothing in these corpora. The surf corpora were not rebuilt for this change (needs the turbo-surf napi + V8 build); the live-geometry Chrome control covers its layout path.
